summary: Researched the evening before (Fri 20 Nov); lineups are not out, so this is a draft until the morning check and the final check. Saturday is a full football day (Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A, La Liga, Ligue 1). Every kept game needs a second price; this time a DraftKings drift of 3% or more against the favourite with no news is treated as low (the warning that came before Troyes slipped on 20 Nov). Eight games were researched; four are medium. Medium: Roma at Parma (Roma unbeaten, 27 pts v 8; DraftKings about 73.5%; Svilar, Mancini and Dybala back), Como v Cagliari (5th v 9th, Cagliari lost three straight; DraftKings about 72%), Man City v Fulham (City have beaten Fulham 20 straight times, but lost three league games in a row and have defensive doubts; DraftKings about 68%), Real Madrid v Celta (eight straight wins, Mbappé fit; DraftKings about 82%; Celta draw a lot). Low: Leverkusen v Paderborn, Monaco v Auxerre and Napoli v Torino (DraftKings drifted 3.5-4% against each favourite with no news), Lazio v Lecce (Gattuso announced rotation and DraftKings drifted). Not researched: PSG at Nice, Leipzig at Union, UFC, tennis. Morning check (Sat 21 Nov): no overnight news hurts the four medium favourites; prices moved slightly toward Man City, Como and Roma and are flat for Real Madrid, with DraftKings in agreement. Parma lose Ndiaye (suspended), Romero and probably Diego Carlos. Lineups are not out, so this is still a draft until the final check.

checks.team_news: Re-checked Saturday morning. Sports Mole (published 20 Nov, 8pm) lists Madrid out: Rodrygo (knee), Asencio (leg), Mendy (hip; last night one source had Mendy back, so he is not certain). Doubtful: Bernardo Silva (leg) and Tchouameni (groin); both trained earlier this week and last night's sources expected them available. Mbappe and Vinicius (ban finished) are expected to start. Mourinho said no serious injuries and many players pushing for places. Celta: no confirmed absentees on Sports Mole, but a long doubt list (Moriba, Sanchez, Nunez, Iglesias, Starfelt, Roman, El-Abdellaoui); the sources disagree on who is out. No new key-starter blow for Madrid found since Friday; I found no Saturday press conference or official injury report beyond these previews.
checks.lineups: Not out yet (official XIs come about 60 min before kick-off, checked at the final check). Morning predicted XIs differ: Sports Mole 4-2-3-1 Courtois; Dumfries, Konate, Huijsen, Cucurella; Valverde, Guler; Diomande, Bellingham, Vinicius; Mbappe. Other outlets have Alexander-Arnold at right-back or Silva in midfield. Last night's Martin's XI had Carreras, Camavinga and Guler. So 2-4 possible changes, no confirmed heavy rotation. Celta predicted (Sports Mole): Radu; Rodriguez, Caceres, Alonso; Rueda, Antanon, Burcio, Carreira; Aspas, Duran, Swedberg.
checks.rotation: Unchanged from last night: Madrid play PSV in the Champions League midweek, so a soft rotation risk, but nothing confirmed. They have won 8 straight in all competitions. Celta schedule not verified.
checks.motivation: Unchanged: Madrid are 2nd with 30 pts, 3 behind Barcelona, and need the points in the title race. Celta are 11th with 13 pts, not in a relegation panic. No hard-rule situation.
checks.form: Unchanged: Madrid have 5 league wins in a row and 8 in all competitions; Mbappe 13 league goals. Celta have 7 draws in 12 league games, no away win this season, and 1 win in their last 5. A draw is the real failure mode.
checks.h2h: Unchanged: Celta won 2-0 at the Bernabeu in Dec 2025; Madrid won 2-1 at Balaidos in Mar 2026. Celta sit deep and a 1-0 or 1-1 is a real path.
checks.odds: Live Polymarket this morning: home 0.8464, draw 0.1073, away 0.0464. Last night: 0.8437 / 0.1028 / 0.0535; first listing is the same, so the favourite is +0.3% since first listed, with the draw up about 0.5 point and Celta down about 0.7 point. Polymarket's 24h favourite move is flat (0.845 to 0.845). No move needs explaining. Second price, DraftKings via ESPN this morning: Madrid -600 (1.17), draw +700 (8.0), Celta +1400 (15.0), de-vigged 0.817 / 0.119 / 0.064. Last night it was 0.821 / 0.120 / 0.060, so DraftKings is essentially unchanged (-0.4 pt for Madrid, well under the 3% drift limit). Polymarket sits about 2.9 points above the DraftKings de-vig, inside the 5-point band, so the independent price agrees. DraftKings total line 3.5 (under -115, over -105); spread now Madrid -2.5 at +115, opened -1.5 at -190, which fits a strong-favourite price. I set p.home at 0.82, below the market.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating obtained (data.rating absent for this club game; ClubElo returned nothing last night). Substitute: Livescore predicts 3-1 and Martin's predicts 3-0 to Madrid; Madrid GD +21 vs Celta 0. Models check is not independently verified.
checks.venue_weather: Santiago Bernabeu, home game, normal venue. No weather or pitch problem found; no Madrid forecast found.

games.reason: Re-checked this morning. No new damaging news: Rodrygo, Asencio and probably Mendy are out; Silva and Tchouameni are doubts who earlier were expected available; Mbappe and Vinicius are fit. The price barely moved (0.8437 to 0.8464) and DraftKings is unchanged (0.817 de-vigged vs Polymarket 0.846, about 2.9 points apart). No hard exclusion applies. Held at medium because of the draw risk against a draw-heavy, deep Celta, possible rest ahead of PSV, and no bookmaker-free rating.
games.main_risk: A draw or a 1-0 / 1-1 result: Celta have 7 draws in 12 games, no away win, a solid defence, and beat Madrid 2-0 at the Bernabeu last December. Mourinho may also rest or lose Silva, Tchouameni or Cucurella before the PSV Champions League game, and Celta's injury list is unclear. Because of this I give no view on Madrid -1.5, team-goals overs or Over 2.5.

checks.team_news: Leverkusen: Rotowire (Fri) says coach Martinez confirmed Kofane (thigh) and Diaby (thigh) available, Kofane possibly as sub first. Bulinews/Yahoo: Tella also expected back, Doue close but behind; Maza (ankle picked up on Algeria duty) doubtful, club hopes he is fit. Sports Mole lists Tella, Terrier and Kofane as out, so sources conflict. Paderborn: only Gayret (knee, out to January) per Sports Mole. No Kettemann press-conference injury list found. Coach Martinez (appointed June 2026) says Paderborn are well prepared and Leverkusen must be strong at the back; Kettemann says it is a demanding away game with focus on defending. Maza's fitness and which internationals returned late are not confirmed.
checks.lineups: Predicted (not official; lineups come out ~60 min before kickoff). Bundesliga.com 4-2-3-1: Flekken; Gutierrez, Medina, Tapsoba, Quansah; Aleix Garcia, E. Fernandez; Moreira, Maza, Diaby; Schick. Sports Mole: same names (Diaby, Maza, Moreira behind Schick). Paderborn 3-3-2-2/3-5-2: Noll; Hansen, Scheller, ter Horst; Curda, Baack, Castaneda, Obermair, Vidovic; Pieringer, Marino. Both outlets agree on the core, Maza is the open question.
checks.rotation: No European or cup game in the window; the match follows the international break. Leverkusen last played the 2-1 win at Koln (Schick's 8th league goal), before that a 4-2 home loss to Stuttgart and a 3-0 loss at Hoffenheim. No rotation signal; Paderborn run about 122 km per game, 2nd highest in the league.
checks.motivation: Table before the game: Leverkusen 5th, 16 pts from 9 (5W 1D 3L, 20:17), 5 points behind Bayern/Dortmund; Paderborn 13th, 10 pts (2W 4D 3L, 8:11), 3 points above the play-off place, so both sides need the points. Not a derby; the favourite has not secured anything, so no hard exclusion. Head coaches: Martinez since June, Kettemann long in post (no change in the last 7 days).
checks.form: Leverkusen league last six W W W L L W; leaky at home lately (4-2 vs Stuttgart, 3-0 at Hoffenheim, 17 goals conceded in 9 games), but won their first five home games. Paderborn W L D W D D, unbeaten in 4 (club record equalled in the Bundesliga), only one away loss all season, 11 conceded in 9 (best start of their top-flight history) but only 8 scored in 9, 2-2 draw with Frankfurt last time. Sources: Bundesliga.com, beIN Sports, Sports Mole. No xG found.
checks.h2h: Leverkusen have never lost to Paderborn in 7 meetings (6W 1D), including a 3-1 DFB-Pokal win at the BayArena (Bulinews listing). Paderborn are a deep, compact, high-running side with little scoring; the likely path to a Leverkusen non-win is a low-scoring 0-0/1-1.
checks.odds: DraftKings via ESPN (https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/soccer/ger.1/scoreboard?dates=20261121): home 1.26, draw 6.0, away 8.0, total 3.5, de-vigged home 0.732, draw 0.153, away 0.115. The opening line was home 1.21, draw 6.5, away 8.0, so the home price has drifted out (implied about 0.826 to 0.794 raw, a fall of about 4% relative). Polymarket over the same period: 0.765 to 0.775 over 24h (+1.3%), so the two sources move in opposite directions and I found no news explaining the DK drift; Kofane/Diaby/Tella return news is positive for Leverkusen, Maza doubt is the only negative. Polymarket volume about $10.9k on the event (home market about $2.3k), liquidity about $305k, so the market is thin. DK de-vigged home is 4 points below Polymarket, hence my p.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating retrieved (ClubElo returned nothing and candidate data has no rating for club games). Sports Mole's model page gives 58.7% / 22.97% / 18.29% and predicts 2-0 (method unknown, lower than the market). I treat this as a gap and shade the home price down 3-4 points.
checks.venue_weather: BayArena, Leverkusen, normal home venue, Sat 21 Nov 14:30 UTC. No weather or pitch problem found, but I did not locate a specific forecast.

games.reason: Verified Bundesliga matchday 10, Leverkusen at home against a mid-table side, no hard exclusion. The favourite's price is supported by the return of Diaby and Kofane, but Leverkusen's defence is leaky, Maza is doubtful, and Paderborn are in record form with the best defensive start of their top-flight history. DraftKings is 4 points below Polymarket on the home win and no rating model was retrieved, so I shade p below the market and rate it medium. Set to low at review: DraftKings lengthened Leverkusen from 1.21 to 1.26 (about 4% against the favourite) with no news found to explain it, the same warning sign that preceded Troyes slipping on 20 Nov; the morning check can restore medium only if the move is explained or reversed.
games.main_risk: A draw (0-0 or 1-1): Paderborn defend deep, concede little, run a lot and are unbeaten in 4, while Leverkusen have conceded 17 in 9 and lost 2 of the last 3 league games; Maza's ankle and returning players' match fitness are unconfirmed, and DraftKings drifted from 1.21 to 1.26 without a clear explanation.

checks.team_news: Unchanged for Roma from Friday: squad of 21 named Fri 20 Nov, Svilar, Mancini and Dybala back per Gasperini's press conference (Dybala's stamina still to be tested); Pellegrini and Rensch out. This morning's press roundup (Goal.com via search) lists Svilar and Gollini as unavailable, but Corriere dello Sport, Forzaroma and other outlets have them back, so I keep last night's reading (single contradictory source). New for Parma: Gilardino's press conference is now found. He said Bernabe is fine and will be called up; Ndiaye is suspended (confirmed); Romero (shoulder dislocation, out until about January) cannot play; Diego Carlos has a muscle problem and Drobnic is not at his best. These Parma absences are bad for the home side. No new news hurting Roma.
checks.lineups: Expected Roma 3-4-2-1 (this morning's previews, Goal.com, RomaNews24, PagineRomaniste, SportParma, in line with last night): Svilar; Mancini, N'Dicka, Hermoso; wing-backs and Cristante/Kone in midfield; Soule, Dybala or Mora; Malen. The open question is still Dybala starting versus Mora. Expected Parma 3-5-2: Daffara; Delprato, Troilo, Carboni (or Drobnic); Britschgi/Cremaschi, Fabbian/Bernabe, Sierro, Keita; Lontani, Touré (Elphege alt). Midfield sources disagree. Not official; XIs come about an hour before kick-off.
checks.rotation: Roma play PSG in the Champions League on Wednesday 25 Nov, still the main soft risk, but nothing this morning points to rotation. Gasperini singled out only Rensch for the PSG game. Roma are rested after the international break (last game 3-0 vs Sassuolo on 7 Nov). Parma also come off the break (lost 1-2 at Bologna on 7 Nov).
checks.motivation: Table after 11 rounds: Lazio 29, Inter 28, Roma 27 (8W 3D 0L, 31 GF 10 GA, unbeaten), Parma 16th on 8 pts (2W 2D 7L, 9 GF 17 GA), in the relegation fight. Roma are chasing the top; Parma need points, but no hard rule is hit.
checks.form: Roma last five (rounds 7-11): W D W W W, unbeaten in the league. Parma last five: L L D W L, only 9 goals in 11 games (0.8 per game), most recently lost 2-1 at Bologna. Gasperini calls it a 'partita trappola' because Parma won 3-0 at Atalanta in that run. A stat quoted by Goalnews24 gives Roma 75.1%, draw 15.4%, Parma 9.5%, close to my numbers.
checks.h2h: Last meeting: Parma 2-3 Roma on 10 May 2026 (single source, BetMines; Malen scored for Roma). Roma are a high-scoring side (2.8 goals per game) against a low-scoring Parma.
checks.odds: Polymarket live: Parma 0.0735, draw 0.1429, Roma 0.7836. Last night it was 0.0835 / 0.1529 / 0.7635, and first listing was 0.7635 for Roma. Roma are up 2.1 points (+2.6%) since first listed, in the favourite's direction, and the move is explained by news: Ndiaye suspended, Romero and Diego Carlos out for Parma, Roma key players back. DraftKings via ESPN ita.1 this morning: Parma +900, draw +500, Roma -425 (decimal 10 / 6 / 1.24), opening +650 / +380 / -320. De-vigged 0.093 / 0.155 / 0.752 against 0.097 / 0.168 / 0.735 last night, so DraftKings has also moved toward Roma by about 1.7 points, with no drift against the favourite. DraftKings is about 3 points below Polymarket on Roma, which agrees within 5 points. Total line 3.5 (under -140, over +110), Roma -1.5 at -150. Polymarket volume is thin.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating available: no rating in the candidates data and ClubElo was unreachable. Substitute is the season record: Roma goal difference +21 in 11 games against Parma -8, 27 pts vs 8. Not an Elo or Opta model.
checks.venue_weather: Stadio Ennio Tardini, Parma, normal home venue, 18:00 local (17:00 UTC) on Saturday 21 Nov. I did not check the weather forecast and found no pitch or weather problem. Parma's coach Gilardino was appointed 29 Sep 2026 (about 53 days ago), so no hard coach rule applies.

games.reason: Roma are 27 pts from 11 unbeaten against a Parma side with 8 pts and 9 goals scored. This morning's news helps Roma: Parma lose Ndiaye (suspended), Romero and probably Diego Carlos, and Roma's Svilar, Mancini and Dybala are back. Polymarket 0.7836 and DraftKings 0.752 de-vigged agree within about 3 points and both moved toward Roma. The Roma win is backed at 0.76, below the market price.
games.main_risk: A draw or upset after the break: Parma are in a relegation fight, Gasperini himself calls it a 'partita trappola', and Dybala is coming back after a month out (limited minutes expected). Roma's Champions League game vs PSG on Wednesday is a soft rotation risk. DraftKings gives the draw 0.155 against Polymarket 0.143. Lineups are not out yet, and one source still lists Svilar as unavailable. I give no view on AH -1.5, +2.5, Over 2.5 or the Roma goals-over leg because a one- or two-goal Roma win, or a Parma blank, is the likely failure.

checks.team_news: Saturday morning update. Como: Kean out for months (Fabregas's press conference, via Sky and the press digest), Diao out; Jesus Rodriguez and Addai were listed out Friday. Chalobah is unlikely to start (Sky). Nico Paz is expected to start despite returning late from Argentina; Perrone is on the bench, not the XI (Sky favours Ricci). Cagliari: Obert, Nzola, Trepy and Fadera recovered; Idrissi back in the squad after 8 months; Winks and Mina still out; Liteta, Juan Rodriguez and Sugawara were on international duty on Friday, but Sky now lists Juan Rodriguez in the XI. No suspensions found for either side. The press conference is now confirmed, but only the Kean remark was seen, so Fabregas's other words are unverified.
checks.lineups: Sky (20 Nov) predicted Como 4-2-3-1: Butez; Couto, Ramon, Kempf, Kaiki; Milla, Ricci; Liberali/Da Cunha, Paz, Baturina/Da Cunha; Douvikas. Outlets disagree on left-back (Kaiki or Valle) and on the midfield pair (Milla with Ricci or Perrone). Cagliari predicted 4-3-2-1: Caprile; Ze Pedro, Deiola, Juan Rodriguez, Obert; Adopo, Romano, Fazzini; Fadera, Maldini; Nzola, with doubts at Trepy/Fadera and Mendy/Nzola. Predicted XIs only; official lineups come later.
checks.rotation: No rotation concern: both sides have no midweek game, Como's last match was before the international break. The only issue is the late return of the Argentina players, and Paz is still expected to start.
checks.motivation: Unchanged from Friday: Como are 5th and chasing the top four, Cagliari are 9th and mid-table, with no hard-rule situation. Cagliari have lost three in a row, so they come into the game short of form and confidence.
checks.form: Unchanged: Como W 3-1 at Torino, W 2-0 Sassuolo, W 3-1 at Fiorentina, 0-0 Roma, L 0-2 Frosinone, W 2-1 Parma. Cagliari have lost three straight and conceded 10 in them.
checks.h2h: Como won 2-1 at Cagliari in March 2026 (comofootball.com). Older head-to-head data is undated, so I do not rely on it.
checks.odds: Live Polymarket Como is 0.7635 (draw 0.1529, Cagliari 0.0835), up 0.9% from 0.7565 at first listing (+0.7 points), with no unexplained move. The 24h move in the candidates data is 0.755 to 0.765. DraftKings via ESPN (ita.1), morning: Como 1.28, draw 5.50, Cagliari 8.50 (Friday night 1.29/5.25/8.50, opening 1.31/4.90/7.50), de-vigged 72.3/16.8/10.9, total line 3.5. The DraftKings favourite price has not drifted away from Como (it shortened slightly), and the book is about 4 points below Polymarket, which is within the 5-point band. My p of 0.73 sits between the two prices and under the market.
checks.models: No ClubElo or Opta rating was read. The table gap (Como 5th, +8 goal difference, against Cagliari 9th, -5) and the DraftKings price are the only rating evidence, so this check is weak.
checks.venue_weather: Stadio Sinigaglia, Como, Saturday 21 Nov, 15:00 local (14:00 UTC). A normal home game; no pitch or weather problem found, though no forecast was read.

games.reason: Como are the clear home favourite (5th against a 9th-placed Cagliari on a three-game losing run). The morning check found no news that hurts them: the press conference and Sky's predicted XIs confirm Paz starting and the same absentees (Kean, Diao). Polymarket Como is up slightly to 0.7635, and DraftKings agrees with Como's strength (1.28, no drift), though it is about 4 points lower than Polymarket, so p is set at 0.73, below the market. Confidence stays medium and not high because XIs are only predicted, Fabregas's remarks beyond Kean are unverified, and Como's attack is thin.
games.main_risk: A draw or a narrow loss. Como are thin up front without Kean, Diao and others, and Paz may be tired after travelling back from Argentina. Como already drew 0-0 at home with Roma and lost 0-2 at Frosinone this season, so a low-scoring game is the real way the favourite fails.

checks.team_news: Lazio out: Nuno Tavares, Marusic (minor setback), Sutalo (all in rehab; Gattuso reassesses next week) and Zaccagni (swelling, decision next week). Frattesi is back from the international break with a minor knock, trained all week and is available. Gudmundsson (shoulder) and Rovella available; Cataldi missed one session, nothing serious. The Danish internationals returned the day after their match. No suspensions or yellow-card risks for either side (Lazionews 20 Nov 21:14, Sky Sport and Il Messaggero Gattuso press conference of 20 Nov). Lecce: Ilic and Pierotti out; Monteiro and Berisha back from individual training and called up (26 called up); Camarda to be assessed on the day (Tuttosport, Lazionews, Calcio Lecce 20 Nov).
checks.lineups: Expected XIs are not confirmed. Lazionews (20 Nov) has Lazio 4-3-3: Mandas; Floriani Mussolini, Leite, Provstgaard, Pedraza; Dele-Bashiru, Belahyane, Taylor; Isaksen, Pinamonti, Noslin. Fantamaster (18 Nov) has Doekhi in for Provstgaard and Frattesi in midfield. The defence and midfield differ by source and Gattuso named no XI. Lecce: 4-3-3 with Falcone; Veiga, Gaspar, Gabriel, Gallo; Coulibaly, Ngom, Maleh; N'Dri, Stulic, Fatah (Lazionews), or 3-5-1-1 with Geubbels and Fatah (Fantamaster). Di Francesco said Monteiro can start.
checks.rotation: Lazio's last game before the break was 1-1 at Napoli on 8 Nov. They went out of the Coppa Italia to Mantova (Lazio Family results 14-18 Nov), so there is no midweek game. The main soft risk is Gattuso's own words: several players who have had little game time will start from the first minute, and he said he will have to rotate (Laziostory, Gold TV 20 Nov). Frattesi and the Danish internationals came back from the break. A derby is next but has no confirmed date in my sources, and Gattuso said it is not on his mind. Lecce took 7 of 10 points away from home and have no stated rotation.
checks.motivation: Lazio are first in Serie A with 29 points, one ahead of Inter and two ahead of Roma (365scores). They are unbeaten and want a win to hold first place. Lecce are 14th with 10 points and need points to stay clear of the bottom. Both sides have something to play for, so no hard exclusion applies.
checks.form: Lazio: 9W 2D 0L, unbeaten (365scores). Recent results: 2-1 v Cagliari (1 Nov), 1-1 at Napoli (8 Nov) after six straight league wins. They have the league's best defence with 9 conceded in 11. Away from home they scored 12 and conceded 3 in their last 4, but at home 9 scored and 5 conceded in their last 4. They have 11 first-half goals in their last 8. Lecce: 3W 1D 7L, recent form D-L-L-L-W, 12 scored and 22 conceded in 11. The Coppa Italia loss to Mantova shows Lazio can slip when they rotate. I found no xG data.
checks.h2h: I did not find recent h2h results in the sources I read, so I am not relying on it. Sarri's older Lazio-Lecce results (2023-24) are not informative with new coaches on both sides. Lecce are well drilled and dangerous on set pieces (Gattuso).
checks.odds: DraftKings via ESPN (https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/soccer/ita.1/scoreboard?dates=20261121): Lazio 1.38, draw 4.70, Lecce 7.00, de-vigged 0.671 / 0.197 / 0.132. The line opened at 1.32 and has drifted out to 1.38, which is a small move away from Lazio. Polymarket 0.704 / 0.183 / 0.114 sits about 3 points above the de-vigged DraftKings price on the favourite. Other Italian books quote Lazio around 1.35-1.40, draw 4.80, Lecce 6.75, over 2.5 at 1.55-1.63 and both teams to score 1.82-1.90 (Spaziocalcio, Agimeg, WebPronostici snippets). The DraftKings total is 2.5. Polymarket 24h move: 0.705 to 0.705, flat. Polymarket event volume is about 42.6k (Lazio win market about 31.6k, Lecce win about 10.8k, draw market about 0.16k), so the draw price is thin.
checks.models: No ClubElo or other bookmaker-free rating was retrievable tonight (the ClubElo API returned nothing, and candidates data.rating is absent for clubs). The proxy is the table and goals record: Lazio 1st with the best defence (0.82 goals conceded per game against a 1.55 league average), Lecce 14th conceding 2.0 per game.
checks.venue_weather: Stadio Olimpico, Rome, Saturday 21 Nov, 15:00 local (14:00 UTC), live on DAZN, referee Marcenaro. This is Lazio's normal home ground with no unusual venue. I found no reports of weather or pitch problems, but I did not check a forecast.

games.reason: Lazio are the clear table-topper and the best defence against a weak 14th-placed side, and the market is in line with DraftKings at 0.67 to 0.70. I lowered the home win p to 0.665, near the DraftKings de-vig, because of the stated rotation (Gattuso: those who played little will start), the Frattesi/Zaccagni/Danes post-break doubts, and Lazio's 9 goals conceded at home in recent games being less tight than away. No hard rule applies: Gattuso is not new, the fixture is not a derby, the venue is normal, and neither side has nothing left to play for. Confidence is medium because there is no bookmaker-free rating and the XI is not confirmed. Set to low at review: Gattuso said several players with little game time will start (rotation announced by the coach), and DraftKings lengthened Lazio from 1.32 to 1.38 (about 4% against the favourite). News that hurts the favourite plus a price move against it is a low under the rules.
games.main_risk: A draw or a narrow 1-0 or 1-1 result against a well-organised Lecce, which is dangerous on set pieces, while Lazio rotate several fringe players (Gattuso said so) after the break and the 0-0 or 1-1 home draw-type games. Their Coppa Italia loss to Mantova shows the cost of rotating.

checks.team_news: Morning update (21 Nov). Sports Mole (Maresca press conference report): Maresca confirmed two City doubts and gave a Guehi update; Guehi is reported to start, the hip problem was a 'small issue' at Forest and not a reason for rest. Other previews are less sure (one says fitness unclear, one still calls him a major doubt), so this is not confirmed. Gvardiol is expected to be available (played the full game for Croatia on 12 Nov despite going off at half-time against Forest); one preview has him moving to centre-back if Guehi is out. Still out: Semenyo (knee). Doubtful: Nunes and Khusanov. Fulham news is unchanged from last night: Smith Rowe and Lecomte out, Cairney doubtful. No new City absence found since Friday. I read only search summaries this morning, not the full press-conference text.
checks.lineups: Predicted City XIs this morning still differ at full-back and wide: Donnarumma; Lewis or Nunes, Dias, Guehi or Gvardiol, O'Reilly; Anderson, Fernandez (or Bouaddi); Doku, Cherki, Foden or Ndiaye; Haaland. Fulham as last night (Leno; Castagne, Affengruber, Bassey, Robinson; Berge, Charles; Bobb, King, Iwobi; Garcia or Muniz). Official lineups not out; to be checked at the final check.
checks.rotation: No change. City have had a full week since the break and no midweek game. No rotation signal for either side. Official lineups will show this.
checks.motivation: No change from last night. City need points after three straight league losses. No hard-rule situation for either side. League table gap still not checked.
